summary: 2048 entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.definitive_edition: Original web/source version by Gabriele Cirulli

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current browser running the original source or official mirror

primary.version: Original Gabriele Cirulli 2048 web version / current official web mirror
primary.why: 2048 began as an open-source browser game by Gabriele Cirulli, and the original web/source route is the cleanest archive target. Official mobile apps are convenience ports, while the many clones should not replace the original.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original web version or a local checkout of the GitHub source. Record browser, source commit or hosted URL, and whether the run uses the official app or a derivative clone.

entries.remaster_caveats: Many clones exist. Record the exact hosted URL or source commit to avoid mixing derivative versions into the original archive entry.
